title: NVIDIA overlay black-screen kill (howto)
desc: T2 howto for nvidia-overlay-blackscreen-kill: detect/kill commands, permanent GeForce Share fix, integrated auto-kill, screensaver self-wipe.
steps: DETECT: wkappbot screensaver close logs '[SCREENSAVER] wiped ... NVIDIA GeForce Overlay'. Or PowerShell: Get-Process 'NVIDIA Overlay' where CPU greater-than 50.
KILL SESSION manually if needed: Get-Process 'NVIDIA Overlay' -EA SilentlyContinue then Stop-Process -Force; Get-Process nvcontainer sort CPU desc select first 2 then Stop-Process -Force.
PERMANENT FIX: GeForce Experience to Settings to Share to toggle OFF -- stops respawn at OS level.

INTEGRATED (v7.3.193+): screensaver close auto-kills NVIDIA Overlay + nvsphelper64 + nvcontainer when a fullscreen black HWND is detected; knownOverlayProcs covers all three, no manual kill needed (code 66a4f31a5).
WKAPPBOT_NO_SCREENSAVER=1 disables the periodic Eye screensaver scan; unset to re-enable the 2s auto-scan.
SCREENSAVER SELF-WIPE: ScreenSaverOverlay.Lifecycle.cs calls WipeBlockingOverlays() every 30s while visible -- auto-wipes fullscreen non-own windows + known overlay procs by name.
author: claude
